import re

def find_char_long(text):
    """
    Finds all words in a string that are at least 4 characters long.
    
    Args:
        text (str): The input string to search.
        
    Returns:
        set: A set of unique words meeting the criteria.
    """
    # \b matches word boundaries, [a-zA-Z]+ ensures we only match alphabetic sequences as "words"
    pattern = r'\b[a-zA-Z]{4,}\b'
    
    return {match.group() for match in re.finditer(pattern, text)}

# Test the function with the provided assertion case
assert set(find_char_long('Please move back to stream')) == {'Please', 'move', 'back', 'stream'}
print("Test passed!")

import re

def find_char_long(text):
    """
    Finds all words in a string that are at least 4 characters long.
    
    Args:
        text (str): The input string to search.
        
    Returns:
        set: A set of unique words meeting the criteria.
    """
    # \b matches word boundaries, [a-zA-Z]+ ensures we only match alphabetic sequences as "words"
    pattern = r'\b[a-zA-Z]{4,}\b'
    
    return {match.group() for match in re.finditer(pattern, text)}

# Test the function with the provided assertion case
assert set(find_char_long('Please move back to stream')) == {'Please', 'move', 'back', 'stream'}
print("Test passed!")
